name: La Forteresse de Kudourt
source:
La Forteresse de Kudourt is a humorous visual novel in which you'll lead your hero and his accomplices through a land full of surprises, only to go talk to the king himself (with the goal of getting an audience before the king to declare your grievances)! Why? The king has forbidden wearing and using weapons during the midday nap time, a decision inciting revolt that will not rest in place without consequences.

[From [url=https://khan-art-studio.itch.io/la-forteresse-de-kudourt] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
La Forteresse de Kudourt是一部幽默的视觉小说，在其中，你将带领你的英雄和他的同伙穿过一片充满惊喜的土地，然后去与国王本人交谈（目标是让观众在国王面前表达你的不满）！为什么？国王禁止在午睡期间佩戴和使用武器，这一决定煽动叛乱，不会不承担任何后果。

[来自[url=https://khan-art-studio.itch.io/la-forteresse-de-kudourt] itch.io[/url]]
